findings.block_barrier: __syncthreads is whole-workgroup and cannot allow producer and consumers to advance independently
findings.feasible_fallback: two LDS-ready/done counters using shared-memory atomics plus block memory fences; requires all five waves resident and must be hang-tested

decision: No native in-tree split-barrier path was found, but the design is not yet structurally blocked. Screen a five-wave atomic-handoff prototype with a timeout-protected actual-weight smoke before any performance claim.
